outcome: differentially expressed long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) genes in human myometrium
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean deliveries who were not in labor (n = 19) and women in spontaneous labor at term (n = 20)
finding: Co-differential expression and correlation of cis-encoded antisense lncRNAs and protein-coding genes with known as well as novel roles in pregnancy are present in the myometrium of women in spontaneous labor at term.
